purpose: Avoid duplicate numbering, semantic duplicates, overwritten assets, and shadow drafts being mistaken for formal files during continuous construction.

check_items.standard: New file prefix does not conflict with existing files.
check_items.failure_action: Use new number; do not overwrite old files.

check_items.standard: Asset id, version, and topic match between md and json.
VAI numbering does not go backwards or reuse an existing number.
Title or status includes shadow, draft, or W1/R0 marker.
Filename does not imply formal launch, publish, or entry.
No delete, move, or rewrite of old assets.
check_items.failure_action: Create new revision or handoff note.

check_items.standard: Key assets preferably have md/json pairs.

check_items.failure_action: Create correction record; do not move old file.
